text:
matt_support: Hey team — customer reports no free-trial credits after signup. They completed email verification and added an Apple Wallet card during onboarding. Account: acct_01GZxQ, user email masked: u***@example.com. No manual grant yet.

vikas_payments: can you paste the signup flow timeline? did the payment-method create event come before or after email_verification?

matt_support: timeline from customer: signup -> clicked email verify link -> redirected back -> tapped Apple Pay -> payment sheet succeeded -> tokenized. They say they saw the success screen but credits never appeared.

emily_ops: tagging ci-bot to pull audit events for acct_01GZxQ, and check autogrant job runs around that epoch. @ci-bot please run `events.lookup --account acct_01GZxQ --since -15m`

ci-bot: got it. events pulled. summary: email_verified @ 2027-06-14T12:03:18Z, payment_method.created (applepay token) @ 2027-06-14T12:03:20Z, payment_method.tokenized @ 2027-06-14T12:03:21Z, autogrant-worker.checked @ 2027-06-14T12:03:20Z (no eligible pm at check time).

vikas_payments: looks like a race: autogrant-worker ran between the `created` and `tokenized` events, so it judged user as no valid pm and skipped autogrant. our autogrant currently only trusts `tokenized` status but job window is tight when Apple Pay redirects back quickly.

matt_support: ok — customer expectation: if they finished the visible flow and payment succeeded, they should get credits. Can we do a quick manual grant and follow up?

emily_ops: manual grant done for acct_01GZxQ — added 50 trial credits. Notified customer.

vikas_payments: root cause: autogrant job schedules use a 2s cadence and reads pm state from cached index that lags on PM tokenizer async callback. Proposed fixes: 1) make autogrant check idempotent and re-check pm status before deciding (quick re-poll up to 3s), 2) treat `payment_method.created` + successful `payment_processor` ack as sufficient for autogrant, or 3) delay worker by 5s for redirects from wallet flows. Prefer 1 & 2.

matt_support: what's the risk of duplicate grants if we re-check? we have idempotency key per account-month, should be safe.

vikas_payments: correct — our grant API is idempotent keyed on signup_event_id so duplicates are safe. I'll open a PR to add a short re-check and include `processor_ack` as a precondition.

emily_ops: please also add better logs for `autogrant-worker` when it skips an account: include last_pm_state and last_processor_ack_ts. that'll make triage easier.

vikas_payments: noted. I'll create a changelist and assign reviewers. Plan: quick hotfix for re-check + logging, then follow-up to consider event-driven autogrant triggered from payment_tokenized webhook.

matt_support: Customer notified and happy with manual grant for now. Leaving this thread open until PR merges. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ci-bot: ticket created: INFR-1542 "autogrant race on wallet redirects" and linked to acct_01GZxQ events.
